subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "Who are you and whom do you want? "I am looking for Mr Nabil." "No Nabil here", said the officer to the stranger.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Mohon asked Sumon what he (S) was doing. Sumon replied that he (S) was doing project work. Mohon asked what the topic of his project work was. Sumon replied that the name was learning by doing. He also added that it was an interesting learning process. Mohon exclaimed with joy and asked if it was really like that. He also exclaimed with wonder that how funny it was. Sakil replied in the affirmative and said that they were enjoying it very much.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Barishal Zilla School, Barishal (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
